title: Series on an episode hint is observed but not required or checked
notes: Jellyfin 12.4 sends Series (the show's name) on each episode hint; a client shows it under the episode. No check holds jellyscale to it. Closed at the pivot: Both auditors: tied to Jellyfin's API, its apps, jellyfin-web or its captures, which go at the cutover (D-107, mandate rule 3).
